messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
The “best” month to visit Hawaii depends on what you’re looking for—weather, crowds, or price—but most travelers agree that **April, May, September, and October** are the sweet spots.

| Month | Why it’s good |
|-------|---------------|
| **April** | Warm, sunny weather; lower hotel rates; fewer tourists after the spring break rush. |
| **May** | Still warm, but the summer crowds haven’t fully arrived; great for beach and outdoor activities. |
| **September** | Weather remains pleasant; the summer heat has eased; many locals return home, so you’ll find more affordable accommodations. |
| **October** | Mild temperatures, lower prices, and the chance to see the first of the fall foliage on the Big Island. |

### Quick weather snapshot (average high/low in °F)

| Month | Avg High | Avg Low |
|-------|----------|---------|
| April | 84 | 66 |
| May | 86 | 68 |
| September | 86 | 68 |
| October | 84 | 66 |

These months offer a balance of sunny skies, comfortable temperatures, and relatively lower crowds compared to the peak summer months (June–August) and the holiday season (December–January). If you’re looking for the absolute best deals, consider traveling in late April or early October.
